name: audit-codingkeys-mappings
description: Audit CodingKeys enums to document the Swift-to-JSON mapping for every tool. Cross-file analysis task.
task: We had a bug where a tool's CodingKeys didn't match the JSON the LLM was sending. Audit every tool arg struct in Sources/Yrden/Tools/ — find which ones define CodingKeys and which ones don't. For each struct with CodingKeys, document the Swift property name → JSON key mapping. Write the full audit to docs/codingkeys-audit.md.
